School Timetable Maker

Build a weekly school timetable: set days and periods, type subjects into each slot, auto-save to your browser and print the finished grid.

Auto-saves as you type. Day names default to Mon–Sun.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how many days and periods per day your week has.
  2. Click Build grid, then type a subject into each slot (optionally with room, e.g. 'Math R12').
  3. Everything saves automatically to your browser as you type.
  4. Press Print for a clean paper timetable.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where is my timetable saved?

In your browser's localStorage under a key namespaced to this tool. It survives reloads on the same browser and device, but is not synced anywhere.

Can I change the number of days or periods later?

Yes — change the numbers and rebuild. Existing entries that still fit are kept; slots outside the new size are dropped.

Does it work for college or coaching schedules?

Yes — days and slots are generic, so it works for any repeating weekly class schedule.
